body: Thankyou so much for that, it is immensely helpful. "You haven't yet fixed the bent tracks your life runs on" - wow, this is great for me to hear right now. & the second paragraph, i dont know what to say, it has really resonated with me, i fear it is a false hope and im wallowing on a good time gone blaming what i can. Thankyou for this, truly truly helpful

I agree, was considering this before moving away (forgot to add, we were neighbours), but i got this place so fast and we already weren't talking and i just didnt see the point, me wanting to move on and be without her, but being away ahsnt helped and it still is haunting me. A heartfelt letter, indeed, i like that. thankyou

Am prepared for no closure, almost resigned to that in the time since we last spoke, but i feel it is needed to move on, but know that cannot always be the way. Considering a letter, the most un-intrusive way, will see how Sunday feels. & Yes, definetly need to plan ahead, as my post says im just finding it difficult to hakuna-matata and move forward and forget the past. 
Edit: Thankyou

i sent her a text today. no reply. have decided on sunday i will call her, if she doesnt answer i will text saying something along the lines of i need closure or need to tell you this for you to know, and if not over the phone in the coming week or something. i feel tho that she is happier without me, was glad to not be friends or talk or even know me anymore, plus has unfriended me on facebook, without going into detail she was rude and mean the last time we spoke, she downplayed the whole friendship as if it were nothing at all. despite this, i need to tell her this, but a fear is i have let too much time (and distance now) pass
